releaseNotes: Release V5.6: Fixed 4 root-cause galaxy rendering bugs: (1) galaxy Z-coord corruption causing stars to rotate behind camera — fixed with group rotation.z instead of per-particle Z mutations; (2) THREE.Clock double-call causing nebula shader time uniform to jump; (3) nebula plane too small causing dark edges; (4) warpZStretch pushing stars past frustum far clip in cockpit mode.
